stemMd: An investment loses 20% in one year. What percentage gain in the next year restores its original value?
explanationMd: An original 100 becomes 80. Recovering 20 on a base of 80 requires 20/80=25%.

distractorRationale.b: Uses the original base instead of the reduced value.
distractorRationale.a: Multiplies the loss rate by the remaining share.
